title: 5% off All in-Stock Items - Online Only @ Mwave
body:
Deal: 5% off All in-Stock Items - Online Only @ Mwave

[twlandre] For your sanity, don't buy anything from MWAVE. Terrible customer support since their website upgrade.
[McFly] Did they ever put back all the customer data?
[brisdaz] Oh this doesn't look good. But digidirect is a good brand?
Mwave Has Been Placed into Administration and Acquired by digiDirect - OzBargain Forums
[twdjlzl] Do they even have any customer support at the moment? Last time been there they spend almost an hour to find where my order is and there is another order I have waited for 5 weeks, still have not yet heard anything from them
[lawyerz] Still waiting for my unifi product to ship…..
[dynaflow] 5%?? pleeeeeeease….I don't get out of bed for less than 20%
[King Steuart] Is this a double dip with the $20 PAX code
[brisdaz] Sorry mods revised my title - check out https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/978716/revisions
[seriousquokka] My order has been delayed by a month. Won’t buy anything from them again.
[boretentsu] I've received more refunds from mwave than actual goods
[Nathw] I returned a $600 worth of item two months ago and still haven’t received my refund. They’ve kept the item and now ghosted me.
[paul04] I have 3 outstanding orders all over a month old, not getting anywhere with them, dont answer calls or emails, put you on hold then hang up, its been a horrible experience, never again.
[binnz001] DO NOT BUY ANYTHING
Terrible customer service
No update on orders
Refuse to refund
More than likely will go bust soon
[USER DC] Cannot agree more,
AND add to that, NEVER PAY WITH CASH/BANK TRANSFER TO THESE GUYS. Always CC only.
[boretentsu] Now with surcharges prohibited this is a no brainer
[pineapple12] Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra is tempting for $175… but after reading these comments I'd rather not deal with a headache
[j0235] Mwave deals should be banned in OzB as they’re scammers
[teddiebear] They used to be a very reputable company. However, since digi-direct took over, their good service basically ended overnight.
I've spent countless $$$ with mwave over the years but haven't bought anything from them in about a year. Now i mostly deal with centrecom and others when there's a good special on.
